parameters.name: Creator
parameters.description: Filters the results by the creator of the pipeline.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can obtain this ID from the Workspace Management page in the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace to use for the API call.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Filters the results by the current status of the pipeline.

Valid values:

- `Init`: initializing

- `Running`: running

- `Success`: succeeded

- `Fail`: failed

- `Termination`: terminated

- `Cancel`: canceled
